prompt: Which resource primarily classifies diagnoses in Australian admitted care?
explain: ICD-10-AM is the diagnosis classification component. Consult current local requirements and the applicable edition.

prompt: Which resource classifies health interventions in the Australian admitted-care classification suite?
explain: ACHI is the intervention classification component of the ICD-10-AM/ACHI/ACS suite.

prompt: What is the role of Australian Coding Standards (ACS)?
options: Guide consistent application of ICD-10-AM and ACHI
Generate a diagnosis from a suffix
explain: ACS supports consistent application of the classifications. Complete documentation and applicable instructions still matter.

prompt: Which is designed to represent detailed clinical concepts, descriptions and relationships?
explain: SNOMED CT is a clinical terminology. Its concepts, descriptions and relationships serve a different purpose from a statistical classification.

prompt: What is the best next step when a fictional note gives an ambiguous abbreviation?
options: Clarify the documented meaning and use authorised references
Infer the diagnosis from the body system
Choose any code sharing its first letter
explain: An abbreviation is not enough to establish a concept. Clarify meaning and verify in the applicable resources.

prompt: A fictional note documents pain and a planned scope examination. What can you conclude?
options: The planned test proves a diagnosis
A word part establishes a disease
Symptoms and a planned procedure are documented; the cause may be unspecified
The procedure and diagnosis have the same classification
explain: Separate symptoms, established conditions and planned procedures. Do not infer an unrecorded diagnosis.

prompt: What should be recorded in an educator-led classification audit trail?
options: Source concept, index route, tabular verification, standards and edition
explain: A defensible learning audit trail identifies the documentation and how the current classification instructions were verified.

prompt: What does an all-numeric SNOMED CT identifier mean to a person reading the digits?
options: The body system can always be decoded from its first digit
It is an unambiguous concept reference without an ascribed human-readable meaning
It is always an ICD-10-AM category
It identifies the recommended medicine dose
explain: SNOMED CT identifiers reference concepts; their digits do not carry an ascribed human-interpretable clinical meaning.
